verified_facts: ETRS89 is the underlying GNSS frame used for GB positioning
OS mapping uses OSGB36 British National Grid
ODN is the mainland GB mean-sea-level height datum
OSTN15 links ETRS89 to OSGB36 National Grid
OSGM15 links ETRS89 heights to national height datums
OSTN15 defines National Grid in conjunction with OS Net
OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is 0.008m
OSGM15 error excludes GNSS heighting errors
OSTN15 agreement with old triangulation network is about 0.1m rms
Lite developer pack has lower accuracy than full model
Lite pack is documented around 0.08m horizontal RMS versus full version
transformation-model accuracy must not be confused with terrain-model accuracy
quality_effect: Separates coordinate/datum transformation uncertainty from terrain uncertainty and rejects reduced-density transforms for high-accuracy candidate binding.
